abstract.para: Learn about &selnx; security settings, pattern-based mode changes and preparation steps for &sap; deployment.

topic.para: To achieve a smooth &sap; software deployment without access denials blocking the installer, &productnameshort; automatically adjusts its security policies when an &sap; pattern is installed. By default, the pattern changes the &selnx; mode from enforcing to permissive.
Follow the information in Using &selnx; with &sap; Workloads before proceeding with the &sap; deployment.
